purpose: Separate total planned projected stop-risk heat from concentration and test whether current sizing is Pareto-dominated on pure risk geometry.

definitions.paretoDominance: another legal same-deployment allocation has <= heat and <= concentration, with at least one strict improvement

guardrails: expected return and PriorityScore alpha are intentionally excluded
risk Pareto dominance is not economic dominance
one-date findings remain structural witness only
no Formal changes from frontier membership
